info.title: API-DocTest-List Hotel Loyalty Points Tiers-v2-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Tiers API provides access to various tiers of loyalty points associated with hotel programs. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about the different loyalty tiers, which can enhance customer engagement and reward management strategies. Typical consumers of this API include hotel chain developers, loyalty program managers, and travel booking platforms. By integrating this API, businesses can effectively communicate tier benefits and incentivize customer loyalty.

get.summary: Retrieve the current tier information for points.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current tier status of points associated with a user. It provides details about the tier level, benefits, and eligibility criteria for upgrading to the next tier.

requestBody.description: This request body must contain the necessary parameters to retrieve the tier information for points. It should specify details such as user ID or account type, depending on the endpoint's requirements.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the points tier information.
